response.sql: WITH invoice_counts AS (SELECT o.order_id, COUNT(i.invoice_number) AS invoice_count FROM Orders o LEFT JOIN Invoices i ON i.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY o.order_id), shares AS (SELECT invoice_count, invoice_count * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(invoice_count) OVER (), 0) AS invoice_share FROM invoice_counts), compared AS (SELECT invoice_count, invoice_share, AVG(invoice_share) OVER () AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT SUM(invoice_count) AS total_invoices, AVG(invoice_share) AS average_share, AVG(invoice_share - average_share) AS average_excess_share FROM compared WHERE invoice_share > average_share
